task.title: P6-023: [parked] Sibling reorder within an unchanged parent has no non-drag path
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Parked — real, deliberately deferred; do not work until its trigger fires). Original id: P6-023. Size: L, design first. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**Reordering a collection among siblings it is already among is drag-only, and therefore mouse-only.** The tree-move task gave reparenting a keyboard and touch path (`Move to…` lands the collection last among its new siblings), but changing position *within* an unchanged parent has no non-drag route — `DropIntent::Before`/`After` fires only on `dragover`/`drop` DOM events (`tree_manage.rs:1070-1072` says so in its own doc comment), so on a phone or from the keyboard sibling order cannot be adjusted at all.

**Trigger: a wireframe or design decision defines the non-drag reorder affordance.** No wireframe specifies one today, so designing it is the first step, not the code.
